_: C組 #2 — package target/location → quest alias. A radiant quest fills aliases (a VIP actor + a dungeon location); its performance packages then ACT on those aliases: travel to the dungeon the alias picked, escort the VIP there. Syntax: 'alias:<name>' (the ref/actor the alias holds → PackageTargetAlias / LocationFallback AliasForReference) or 'aliasLoc:<name>' (the location a location-alias holds → LocationFallback AliasForLocation). ownerQuest MUST be in-spec so alias indices resolve. ⚠ Mutagen field shape is reflection-verified, but whether AliasForReference vs AliasForLocation / PackageTargetAlias byte-matches a real radiant package needs a main-machine xEdit compare (see WAIT_USER). FormIDs verified vs Skyrim.esm 2026-06-17: VIP forced fill = HousecarlWhiterun(Npc) 0x0A2C8E; Safehouse findMatchingLocation LocType keyword = LocTypeDungeon(Keyword) 0x0130DB; package templates = Travel(PackageTemplate) 0x016FAA + Escort(PackageTemplate) 0x023B73 (both confirmed correct, unchanged).

aliases.name: VIP
aliases._: alias index 0 — forced to HousecarlWhiterun (Lydia, Npc 0x0A2C8E). The `packages` list is the ALPS alias-override that actually DRIVES her: while this alias is filled she runs MFTravelToSafehouse (highest priority first), so she walks to the runtime-picked Safehouse location. WITHOUT this list the PACK record exists but never runs — the package's PackageTargetAlias/LocationFallback alone do nothing.

aliases.name: Safehouse
aliases._: alias index 1 — a Dungeon-type location picked at runtime via LocTypeDungeon keyword (0x0130DB).

packages._: Travel to the LOCATION the Safehouse alias holds (aliasLoc: → AliasForLocation).
Escort the VIP actor (alias: target) to the Safehouse location (aliasLoc: destination).
